g.text: decode step t (at step t the request holds P + t tokens of KV, for L steps)
P = 1,500 prompt tokens, held from the first decode step
the area is memory × time per request
computed by rlcore.workload.kv_token_steps: the area is P·L + L(L + 1)/2 (P = 1,500)
